name: staffmor
description: Staffmor's AI team: 91 roles and methods for work, business, creative and personal projects, the same skills Staffmor members use.

interface.shortDescription: The roles your AI team uses
interface.longDescription: Staffmor's AI team in one plugin: 91 roles and methods, from accountant, researcher and writer to software engineer, web designer, marketing and SEO partner, and personal planner. Each skill gives your agent a practical procedure, the inputs it needs, how to check its work and where to stop for your decision. These are the same skills Staffmor members select in their office. Third-party adaptations keep their authors' credit and MIT licenses.
defaultPrompt: Act as my accountant and reconcile these entries
Be my research and decision partner on this choice
Write a welcome email sequence for new signups
